w10_T4_003961: The Elmwood charity walk raised a pot of money on Sunday. In the morning each of the 8 walkers handed in 83 dollars of sponsorship, and a cake sale added 51 dollars to the pot. The route was 10 kilometres long. In the afternoon a local company added enough to make the pot 3 times as large as it had been. In the evening the organisers divided the pot equally among 5 charities, and the animal shelter was one of them. A late donor then gave 24 dollars directly to the shelter's share. How many dollars did the animal shelter end up with?
w10_T4_003968: The fresh-water tank on Ito's fishing boat held 184 litres when he left the harbour. During the first half a day at sea he used 55 litres for cooking and washing. A rain squall let him collect 33 litres into the tank. He then used 149 litres to hose down the deck after a big catch. A slow leak lost another 9 litres before he noticed it. How many litres of water are in the tank now?
w10_T4_003971: The Harbour Street food bank received 3 pallets with 136 cans of soup on each, and a church donation added 52 more cans. The manager planned to hand out all of those cans in equal amounts over the 4 days the food bank is open this week. On top of the planned cans, a neighbour drops off 32 extra cans every open day, and those are handed out the same day. The food bank has 6 volunteers on its roster. How many cans of soup will the food bank hand out over those 4 days in total?
w10_T4_003976: Ravi manages the water supply for a charity run. In the morning he set out 208 bottles at the aid station, and a delivery van added 48 more. At midday he opened a second table stocked with exactly as many bottles as the first, so the station now had 2 tables of equal size. In the afternoon a neighbouring station handed over 37 bottles. In the evening the organiser told Ravi to prepare 4 stations for the weekend, each stocked with the same number of bottles his station had at the end of the day. How many bottles must Ravi prepare for the weekend in total?
w10_T4_003980: Ana, who is a dozen years old, had 188 postage stamps in her album. Her friend Ben had only 45 stamps, far fewer than Ana, and he gave her all of them when he lost interest in collecting. Ana then sold 185 stamps to a dealer. At a swap meet another dealer gave her 18 free stamps to welcome her. She later gave 65 stamps to her cousin. How many stamps does Ana have in her album now?
w10_T4_003981: Sofia bought 4 prepaid calling cards, each loaded with 96 minutes, and put all of the minutes onto her account. She used 289 minutes calling her parents overseas and then 84 minutes talking to a friend. The phone company then ran a promotion that made her remaining balance 2 times as large. She then spent 12 minutes on a call to the bank. The company bills in hours rather than minutes, so Sofia knows she will have to convert at the end of the month. How many minutes are left on Sofia's account?
w10_T4_003984: Leah spent the morning in the orchard and picked 100 apples before breakfast and 67 more before noon. In the afternoon she picked another 28. She picked exactly that same number on each of 3 days, and her brother picked exactly as much as she did over those days, so the 2 of them had equal piles. In the evening of the third day they combined their piles and divided all the apples equally into 3 market crates. How many apples are in each crate?
w10_T4_003985: At the start of the lunch rush a parking garage held 140 cars. Within half an hour 45 more cars drove in. Then 55 cars left for the afternoon, and 8 more left shortly after. A conference let out and 65 cars drove in. How many cars are in the garage now?
w10_T4_003987: At a tile warehouse the loading bay was empty when the morning shift began. Each rack holds 140 tiles, 3 racks fit on a trolley, and during the morning 8 trolleys were wheeled into the bay every hour for 3 hours. In the afternoon a quality check returned 33 tiles to the bay, and a second check returned 41 more. In the evening a truck took 5782 tiles away for delivery. How many tiles are in the loading bay now?
w10_T4_003988: Jo sells cookies from a stand outside her house and keeps her books in cents, converting to dollars later since a hundred cents make a dollar. She priced each cookie at 24 cents but knocked 3 cents off the price for the neighbours. On Monday she sold 5 cookies at that reduced price and also found 33 cents left in the tip cup. Jo is 9 years old. She took exactly the same amount as Monday on each of 6 days. She then spent 619 cents on flour and 123 cents on butter. How many cents does Jo have left?
w10_T4_003990: Ola collected 78 seashells on each of 3 days at the beach. Her friend Nils collected only 57 shells over the whole trip, far fewer than Ola. Ola donated 232 of her shells to the school nature display. Nils then gave Ola all 57 of his shells because he had no room for them. On the drive home 4 of Ola's shells broke and were thrown away. How many shells does Ola have now?
w10_T4_004005: A film editor named Bao had a rough cut that ran 190 minutes, and the studio wants runtimes in hours, so he knows that sixty minutes make an hour and will convert when he is done. He trimmed 43 minutes of slow scenes. The director then asked him to add back a 28-minute battle sequence and a 29-minute flashback. Bao also added 24 minutes of end credits and bonus footage. The film has 6 main characters and took a dozen weeks to shoot. How many minutes long is the cut now?
w10_T4_004007: Rae mixed granola for a hiking trip, weighing everything in grams though the recipe card is written in kilograms, so she remembered that a thousand grams make a kilogram. She made 3 batches of 118 grams each, and then ate 46 grams while taste-testing. She divided what was left into 4 equal portions, one for each day of the first stretch of the hike. For the full trek she decided she actually needed 7 portions of that same size, so she made up exactly that many. Her hiking partner Jun then ate 175 grams straight from the bag, which was far more than the 46 grams Rae had eaten. How many grams of granola are left for the trek?
w10_T4_004012: Farmer Quinn started the spring with 28 hens. She sold 3 of them to a neighbour and then raised 48 chicks that grew into laying hens. The coop has 5 nesting boxes. Later she sold 60 hens at the county auction. Each of the hens she has left lays 7 eggs a week. How many eggs will her hens lay in 4 weeks?
w10_T4_004015: At the arcade Milo had 155 prize tickets and spent 151 of them on a stuffed dinosaur. A bonus machine then tripled the tickets he had left. Over the next hour he won 56 tickets at skee-ball, 50 at the basketball hoop, and 48 at the claw machine. How many prize tickets does Milo have now?
w10_T4_004018: In the morning Kira checked her 6 seed trays: each tray had 162 seeds in it, she added 66 seeds to each tray, and then she found that 122 seeds in every tray had failed to sprout, so she counted the sprouted seedlings across all 6 trays. In the afternoon she sold 320 of those seedlings at the farm gate. In the evening she took 6 cuttings from each seedling she had left, and a friend dropped off 6 extra cuttings. The greenhouse is 15 metres long, and Kira records the height of the cuttings in centimetres even though the catalogue lists it in metres, a hundred centimetres to a metre. How many cuttings does Kira have now?
w10_T4_004020: Zoe collected 33 pine cones in the park while Max collected 50 by the river, so Max gathered more than Zoe. On the way home they picked up 29 more cones outside the school and put everything into one bag. The craft teacher needs 5 cones for each wreath. Zoe and Max divided the bag equally between the 2 of them. Max then found 4 more cones under a bench and kept them. How many pine cones does Max have?
w10_T4_004027: In the morning each delivery van at the Northgate depot was loaded with 211 parcels plus 4 priority envelopes. The depot has 9 loading doors. Each route is served by 4 vans loaded that way. In the afternoon the dispatcher counted 6 routes that had gone out fully loaded. In the evening 10 late parcels were sent out by bicycle courier on top of that. How many parcels and envelopes did the depot send out that day?
w10_T4_004032: Beekeeper Nora weighs her honey in grams, though the market stall sells it by the kilogram and she knows a thousand grams make a kilogram. Her collection jar held 220 grams of honey on Monday. On Tuesday she added 71 grams, on Wednesday 53 grams, and on Thursday 12 grams. The jar is 14 centimetres tall. On Friday she spooned out 59 grams for a batch of granola. How many grams of honey are in the jar now?
w10_T4_004041: In the morning the Rise and Shine bakery had 139 bagels on its racks and sold 56 of them before nine. A customer returned 3 bagels that were the wrong flavour, and those went back on the rack. In the afternoon a cafe down the street bought a dozen, and 15 more went to the staff for lunch. The bakery runs 4 ovens. In the evening the baker put out 57 fresh bagels for the dinner crowd. How many bagels are on the racks now?
w10_T4_004046: The Seaview Hotel had 140 clean towels in its linen room. The hotel has 48 guest rooms. Housekeeping sent 119 of the towels out to be laundered. Later that day 65 towels came back from the laundry and a delivery brought 35 brand-new towels. The pool attendant then took 100 towels down to the pool deck. How many towels are in the linen room now?
w10_T4_004050: Tomas rode his bike 107 kilometres on each of 6 days during a tour he had spent a dozen days planning. His bike weighs 9 kilograms. When his tracking app crashed it wiped 613 kilometres from his logged total. He rode 46 kilometres the next day and 57 kilometres the day after, and both rides were logged. The app displays distance in metres rather than kilometres, so Tomas keeps in mind that a thousand metres make a kilometre. How many kilometres does the app show as his logged total now?
w10_T4_004051: In the morning Oren sold 7 hand-painted mugs at the craft fair for 136 cents each and put the money in his pouch. He paid 331 cents for a coffee and found 16 cents on the ground, which he added to the pouch. In the afternoon he spent 514 cents on lunch, after standing in line for half an hour. The fair had 11 rides. In the evening he staked everything in the pouch on a ring-toss game that paid out 6 times the stake, and he won. He then spent 732 cents on a bus ticket home. How many cents does Oren have left?
w10_T4_004057: The children's shelf at the Maple Street library held 197 books when the doors opened in the morning. During the morning 107 books were borrowed from that shelf. In the afternoon 67 books were returned to it and a librarian added 63 newly purchased books. In the evening another 43 returned books were put back on the shelf. How many books are on the children's shelf at closing time?
w10_T4_004058: In the morning Emil counted 203 marbles in his bag, and his friend Faye, who had only 44 marbles and therefore far fewer than Emil, gave him all of hers. The tournament that day had 10 rounds. During the morning rounds Emil lost 244 marbles. In the afternoon a trader offered him 6 marbles for every marble he had left, and Emil accepted, handing over all of his marbles. In the evening he lost 9 marbles in a final game and then won 28 in a rematch. How many marbles does Emil have now?
